# render

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ScriptClientCamera`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientCamera) | Controls the local player's camera. |
| [`ScriptClientHand`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientHand) | First-person hand of the local player, from `c.getPlayer().getHand("main")` or `getHand("off")`: moves, turns and hides the hand and its item, at once or smoothly. |
| [`ScriptClientHud`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientHud) | One element of the vanilla Minecraft HUD of the client player, such as the hotbar, hearts or chat. |
| [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) | Settings of a camera shake, created by `scram.shake()` and started with the camera's `shake` or `impulse`. |
| [`ScriptClientWorldRenderer`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientWorldRenderer) | Draws lines, boxes, text, items and blocks in the world for the current frame. |
